summary.text: Robert Moesinger, an unaffiliated systems and automation engineer who describes himself as not a politician, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Utah's 2nd Congressional District to Blake Moore.
He earned a graduate degree from the University of Utah in 2018.

paragraphs.text: Robert Moesinger graduated from Ogden High School and earned a graduate degree from the University of Utah in 2018.
According to his survey, he works as a systems and automation engineer, studying manufacturing systems, analyzing data and correcting process flaws.
He describes himself as a first-time, non-politician candidate and a Utah father who plays board games with his family, and says his faith is the foundation of his moral framework.
During the campaign, he ran primarily on replacing the two-party system with multi-party democracy, including ranked choice voting in multi-member House districts.
He received 2.6% of the vote to Blake Moore's 50.1%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
